retired.scope: The two second-brain routes below (mera-second-brain-capture, mera-second-brain-recall). They used to point at a `mera` Skill package; that package was removed from this repository on 2026-08-18, so the routes no longer name any Skill to install. The doubaoya-public-discovery route below is unaffected and still valid.
historical_facts: 2026-08-10: the doubaoya production stack migrated to a new host; the Mera second-brain service did not migrate and entered retirement on the old host.
The DNS record for mera.doubaoya.com has been removed; the name resolves to NXDOMAIN on public resolvers.
call_outcome: All six api.mera.* capabilities fail. Deployments without a configured backend address are stopped by the availability gate BEFORE any credit is debited and return 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (no charge at all).
Deployments still holding the stale old-host address cannot reach it and return 502 PROVIDER_FAILED, with the debited credits refunded automatically.
Neither path leaves the user out of pocket, and neither returns data. Retrying, changing keys, changing parameters and changing networks are all pointless.
agent_behaviour: Tell the user plainly that the second-brain capability has been retired, then ask what they would like to do instead.
There is NO substitute skill and NO acceptable degradation.

Never fall back to doubaoya-public-discovery for a first-person request: public platform search cannot see the user's own notes, so answering 我之前说过什么 from public content passes strangers' material off as the user's own memory — worse than saying the capability is gone.
retired.discovery_visibility: Do not infer anything from the discovery listing, in either direction. The six mera/* entries are flagged hidden, and hidden entries are filtered out of GET /api/apis while GET /api/apis/mera/<slug> answers the same 404 as a slug that never existed; older deployments that predate that flag still list them with prices. So you may find them or not find them depending on the build you are talking to, and neither observation changes the answer: absent from the listing is not 'try again later', and present in the listing is not 'callable'. Decide from this block, never from the listing.
retired.invalidated_when: This retirement block expires once mera.doubaoya.com resolves again (no longer NXDOMAIN) AND an api.mera.* call returns real data instead of 503/502. At that point restore the call contracts rather than trusting this file.

use_when: user asks to remember, note down, save, or bookmark something for themselves
user says 帮我记一下 / 记下来 / 存进笔记 / 备忘一下 / 我刚想到
user pastes a link and asks to keep it in their own notes
user dictates a decision, idea, or todo that must survive this conversation
contract: Writes are asynchronous: always use `remember`, never report success before status=done.
Translate disposition into plain words; state failed outcomes explicitly.
Only deduplicated === true may be reported as a duplicate; a missing field never means first-time capture.
title applies to content mode only and never changes an existing record; url mode ignores it.

use_when: user asks what they themselves previously said, recorded, decided, or collected
user says 查查我的笔记 / 我之前是不是说过 / 我记过什么 / 关于 X 我有哪些素材
user asks for their own stance or conclusion (我对 X 怎么看 / 我当时为什么这么决定)
user asks who they are or asks the agent to write in their own voice (我是个什么样的人 / 按我的风格写)
contract: Default path is search -> read -> synthesize locally: search returns 240-char snippets plus absolute char offsets, read returns the real source text around them.
`ask` is demoted: use it only when the user needs the deterministic evidence grade as a trust signal, or wants the exchange recorded in the mera.doubaoya.com conversation list.
Never default to `ask`: it bills a second LLM for an LLM consumer, adds a round trip, and only sees query_text without the current conversation context.
Every `ask` answer must carry citations[].raw_source.title; never invent a source.
evidence_level === "none" is the only no-support predicate; evidence.grade is not, because reference-level evidence shares the same grade.
When evidence_level is "none", say so in Chinese and never relay Mera's English placeholder answer.
Take `self` once per session for tone, not on every turn; persona_core may be null and must not be invented.

use_when: user asks what is trending, viral, or popular on public platforms
user asks about other people's accounts, articles, notes, or videos
user wants topic ideation sourced from public platform data rather than personal notes

precedence: Any route marked "retired": true is never selected. Its use_when list is kept only so you can RECOGNISE the request and answer that the capability is retired — it is no longer a routing target.
First-person possessive scope (我的 / 我之前 / 帮我记) still identifies a second-brain request; because both second-brain routes are retired, the correct response is to say so, not to route anywhere.
Public discovery intent without first-person scope selects doubaoya-public-discovery, which is unaffected by the retirement.

When a request mixes both (e.g. research a trend then keep it), run the public route and deliver its result, then state plainly that the keeping step is unavailable because the second brain has been retired.

request_signals: reported as saved without a done receipt
forbidden_misroutes.reason: An unconfirmed write reported as success loses the user's material without them knowing.

request_signals: personal note content forwarded to another service
forbidden_misroutes.reason: Second-brain content is private and evidence-bound; unsourced answers and outbound leaks both break that contract.

Public platform search cannot see the user's own second brain and would answer from strangers' content. Since the second brain was retired this is the single most likely mistake: with no mera route left to take, an agent is tempted to substitute public search. Say the capability is retired instead.

request_signals: calling POST /api/apis/mera/<slug>/call on the strength of the discovery listing — whether the entry is still visible there or has already been filtered out as hidden
treating the entry's disappearance from GET /api/apis as a transient listing glitch worth calling through anyway
retrying a mera 503 or 502 in the hope it is transient
reporting a note as saved when the write could not have happened
forbidden_misroutes.reason: The mera capabilities are retired and cannot succeed. The discovery listing is not the evidence either way — see `discovery_visibility` in the top-level `retired` block.
